answer: Here is one mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. The required words slot into it cleanly: vault mirrors the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, atlas captures the random sampling that seats juries, and anchor maps onto the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture. Honesty is simply the cheapest strategy in this ledger.
